entries.description: On-device AI: a web app that downloads a small open language model once and runs chat inference entirely in the visitor's browser (WebGPU via WebLLM, CPU fallback via wllama). No server, no API key, no account; nothing typed leaves the device. Free.
representativeQueries: chat with a language model in my browser
run an LLM locally without a server
which small model fits my device

entries.description: Agent Skills index for On-device AI: chat-on-device, compare-models, diagnose-device. Each skill documents a real workflow an agent can walk a user through.
representativeQueries: how do I chat with the on-device model
is my device fast enough for local AI

entries.description: auth.md for On-device AI: how agents authenticate. There is no API, no key, and no OAuth — this file says so plainly so agents do not go hunting for credentials.
